The '''Cliffside''' was, along with the [[Icicle]], one of the two cantinas in [[Elesa]], the small [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], at some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].
